PRIYANKA NAIR
Kochi, Kerala | priyanka.nair@example.com | +91-00000-00701

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
HR generalist with close to seven years across people operations for
consumer and hospitality businesses of 120 to 400 employees. End-to-end
recruitment coordination, structured onboarding programmes, HRIS
administration, monthly payroll inputs, and hands-on Indian labour
compliance. Known for calm, well-documented process and quick, practical
support to managers.

SKILLS
- Recruitment: sourcing coordination, structured interviews, offer management
- Onboarding: induction facilitation, 30-60-90 plans, buddy programmes
- HRIS: PeopleCore HRIS administration, employee data audits, access control
- Payroll: monthly payroll inputs, attendance and leave reconciliation
- Compliance: PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments filings, POSH
- General: policy drafting, grievance handling, engagement surveys

EXPERIENCE

Senior HR Executive — Tealwood Consumer Brands, Kochi
June 2021 to April 2025
- Ran recruitment coordination for 25 to 35 open roles per quarter across
  sales, supply chain, and corporate functions; median time to offer of
  24 days.
- Redesigned onboarding into a structured two-week programme; 90-day new
  hire attrition fell from 18% to 7%.
- Administered the PeopleCore HRIS for 380 employees: data hygiene audits,
  role-based access, and quarterly headcount reconciliation.
- Prepared monthly payroll inputs covering attendance, incentives, and full
  and final settlements, with zero payroll reruns in the final two years.
- Owned labour compliance calendars: PF, ESI, gratuity, and Shops and
  Establishments filings across three states, all submitted on time.
- Ran the annual engagement survey and the manager action-planning cycle.

HR Executive — Lantern Hills Hospitality, Kochi
August 2018 to May 2021
- Coordinated high-volume recruitment for front-office and kitchen roles,
  averaging 15 hires per month in season.
- Ran onboarding and documentation for a 240-person property.
- Maintained employee records in the HRIS and processed lifecycle changes.
- Compiled payroll inputs and coordinated with the external payroll bureau.
- Supported statutory compliance audits with zero adverse findings.
